name: Clearfile
description: A full product-led SaaS with cinematic opening, three-view interactive document workspace, sticky workflow narrative, and a working local review room.
tagline: The work’s ready. Bring everyone with it.

notes.layout: full-width atmospheric hero, multi-view product window, original document artwork, sticky workflow panels, review room and pricing
notes.motion: scroll-linked hero and workflow motion, product-view transitions, document-change feedback, reduced-motion fallback
notes.interaction: switch product views, complete a local handoff checklist, search documents, save review decisions and notes, compare billing periods
notes.provenance: Original three-page SaaS study with independently composed layout, product interface, copy, sample data, and generated imagery. No reference assets or source included.
